name: m5-gpu-ac5
description: AC5 rerun. The 2026-11-11 campaign's overload test ran at ~0.5-1x of true saturation because of a biased saturation rule (fixed in 3685485), and with a TTFT predictor that over-predicted 10-50x (fixed in 939e134). This run measures the native engine's saturation with the corrected rule, then offers 2x the highest unsaturated rate with the 2 s TTFT deadline and without it (control). Pre-registered AC5 criteria unchanged. The original results are kept.
label: GPU-A16x1-vultr
